sentences.en: He argued for our forming the alliance with that nation.
sentences.zh: 他主张我们与该国结盟。

sentences.en: Defence alliances are an essential part of German security policy.
sentences.zh: 防御联盟是德国安全政策的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: Japan entered into an alliance with France just before the war.
sentences.zh: 日本在战争爆发前与法国缔结了同盟。

senses.zh: （国家、政党等的）结盟，同盟，联盟，联合,联姻,同盟条约,同盟者
